name: Moon Woo-jin
bio: Moon Woo-jin (born February 19, 2009), is a South Korean actor. He made his acting debut in 2016 and has since had roles in television series What's Wrong with Secretary Kim (2018), Once Again (2020), and The Atypical Family (2024).
